verdict.rationale: Jev documents model-level versioning (jev-latest/jev-preview aliases resolving to pinned versions like jev-1.13.0) and advises pinning a specific version if you've tuned confidence thresholds, giving a rudimentary rollback mechanism for model behavior. However, there is no evidence of versioning, reviewing, or rolling back the actual user-built 'automations' (decision logic/workflows) themselves — no history UI, diff/review tooling, or automation-level rollback feature is documented. missing for 10: automation/workflow version history, a review mechanism for changed logic, and a rollback UI/API for user-authored automations (not just model pinning).
